content.short: ClearBank is an API-native UK clearing bank that provides accounts and payments to fintechs and digital asset firms.
content.description: ClearBank was the first new clearing bank in the UK in a couple of centuries, and it exists so that fintechs can offer genuine bank accounts without becoming a bank themselves. Client money sits at the Bank of England rather than with an intermediary, which matters when the alternative is a chain of correspondent relationships nobody can see through. The product covers accounts, payments, multi-currency and foreign exchange, with a dedicated line for digital asset platforms. Customers include Coinbase and Kraken, and a European arm is regulated in the Netherlands.
